question: The people of Kashmir dedicates the Navreh festival to Goddess _______ and pay homage to her during the festival.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Sharika.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct answer to the question is option 3, Sharika.**
 
• ** Navreh** is a festival celebrated by the people of** Kashmir to mark the beginning of the Hindu New Year.**
 
• The festival is dedicated to Goddess Sharika, who is believed to be the **presiding deity of the city of Srinagar.**
 
• ** The people of Kashmir pay homage to the goddess by offering prayers **and seeking her blessings for a prosperous and peaceful year ahead.
 
• Sharika is also known as Tripura Sundari and is considered to be a form of the goddess Shakti.
 
• Sita, is incorrect as she is not associated with the Navreh festival or worshipped during this time in Kashmir.
 
• Parvati is also incorrect as although she is a revered goddess in Hinduism, she is not specifically worshipped during Navreh in Kashmir.
 
• Lakshmi is also not associated with the Navreh festival in Kashmir, although she is worshipped during other Hindu festivals such as Diwali.
 
• It is important to note that the worship of Goddess Sharika during Navreh is a unique tradition of the people of Kashmir, and is not widely celebrated in other parts of India.
